name: Natal Orbit
subtitle: Your birth sky, in 3D
promotionalText: Enter your birth date, time and city and watch the sky you were born under spin in 3D. Big Three, planets, aspects, transits. Pay once: no ads, no subscription.
description:
Natal Orbit draws the exact sky you were born under as a living 3D orrery, then reads it to you in plain English. Pay once, keep it forever. No ads, no subscription, no account.

YOUR SKY, SPINNING
Enter your birth date, time and city. Natal Orbit places the Sun, Moon and every planet exactly where they were at that moment, lit by a real ephemeris, and lets you spin, pinch and fly through it.

YOUR BIG THREE
Sun, Moon and Rising, explained in a few warm lines each: who you are, what you need, how you come across. Don't know your birth time? Say so and Natal Orbit skips the Rising instead of guessing.

EVERY PLANET, EVERY ASPECT
Mercury to Pluto, each with its sign, house and degree. Conjunctions, trines, squares and oppositions drawn on a classic chart wheel, with tight orbs and a one-line read for each.

HOUSES YOUR WAY
Placidus by default, Whole Sign with one tap.

TODAY, FROM REAL TRANSITS
See where the planets are right now against your chart. The Moon's phase and sign, and the transits that actually touch you today.

YOUR YEAR AHEAD
The slow planets' moves over the next twelve months, month by month, with what each one tends to bring.

COMPARE TWO CHARTS
Add a friend or partner and see where your skies meet: shared signs, cross aspects, the easy spots and the sparks.

SHARE IT
Make a share card of your Big Three or your chart wheel, sized for stories, posts or your lock screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your birth data stays on your iPhone. No account, no servers, no analytics. Works fully offline.

Natal Orbit is for reflection and fun; it does not predict events or replace professional advice.
